question: How many cards with print rarity have ruling text printed on 01/02/2007?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "card_rulings" AS SELECT r.uuid, c.rarity, r.rq, r.nr FROM table_2 r INNER JOIN table_1 c ON r.uuid = c.uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  '2007-01-02' AS ruling_date_assumed,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS card_count
FROM card_rulings
WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(rarity), ''), NULL) IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(nr), ''), NULL) IS NOT NULL
  AND rq = '2007-01-02';
